An '''automated Imperial surveillance ship''' had crashed on the planet [[Kajim]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Imperial operatives were able to drive off the Republic retrieval team and reclaim it for the Empire.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Data Race}}</ref>
